verdict.rationale: Factory's docs explicitly describe the target workflow ('A designer shares a mockup, and the system implements it without handoffs') and general delegate-diff-merge flow, matching the story directly, but this is a single thin doc line with no elaboration on how mockups/designs are ingested, no PM-specific UI walkthrough, and no independent or hands-on corroboration. missing for 10: detailed mechanism for mockup ingestion (image/design-tool support), PM-focused UX evidence, independent/hands-on verification that non-engineers can actually complete this end-to-end.
